entries.title: Ezekiel 19:1
segments: ¶"Moreover take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:2
segments: "and say: 'What [is] your mother? A lioness: She lay down among the lions; Among the young lions she nourished her cubs.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:3
segments: She brought up one of her cubs, And he became a young lion; He learned to catch prey, And he devoured men.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:4
segments: The nations also heard of him; He was trapped in their pit, And they brought him with chains to the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:5
segments: 'When she saw that she waited, [that] her hope was lost, She took another of her cubs [and] made him a young lion.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:6
segments: He roved among the lions, And became a young lion; He learned to catch prey; He devoured men.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:7
segments: He knew their desolate places, And laid waste their cities; The land with its fullness was desolated By the noise of his roaring.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:8
segments: Then the nations set against him from the provinces on every side, And spread their net over him; He was trapped in their pit.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:9
segments: They put him in a cage with chains, And brought him to the king of Babylon; They brought him in nets, That his voice should no longer be heard on the mountains of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:10
segments: ¶'Your mother [was] like a vine in your bloodline, Planted by the waters, Fruitful and full of branches Because of many waters.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:11
segments: She had strong branches for scepters of rulers. She towered in stature above the thick branches, And was seen in her height amid the dense foliage.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:12
segments: But she was plucked up in fury, She was cast down to the ground, And the east wind dried her fruit. Her strong branches were broken and withered; The fire consumed them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:13
segments: And now she [is] planted in the wilderness, In a dry and thirsty land.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:14
segments: Fire has come out from a rod of her branches [And] devoured her fruit, So that she has no strong branch-a scepter for ruling.'" This [is] a lamentation, and has become a lamentation.
